baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟, anchored in ل ي س, ش ي ء, and ق و م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The present negation removes any claim to a stable standing, while establishment activates straightness plus sustained care. The written or binding corpus becomes load-bearing only when a community keeps it upright as an operative order.

activation_trace.role: The Book as an established ordinance supplies the corpus whose title alone cannot confer standing.
The frozen present negation cancels the addressees' claimed condition before the until-clause is met.
The maximally general reportable thing makes the denied standing comprehensive rather than merely deficient.
Straightness and balance make establishment an enacted alignment, while the second occurrence keeps that alignment social.
Sustained care, preservation, and governance keep establishment from collapsing into a one-time recital.

changed_reading.before: Possession of named scriptures appears to provide a religious standing that may simply be judged inadequate.
changed_reading.after: The verse suspends standing altogether until the community makes the written and descended corpus stand through balanced, sustained enactment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَآ أُنزِلَ ... وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ ... طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا, anchored in ن ز ل, ز ي د, ط غ ي, and ك ف ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A delivered input from the Lord is grammatically the thing that adds, but its named result in many receivers combines boundary-crossing overflow with covering. The focus therefore presents revelation as an amplifier of a reception trajectory, not as neutral information whose effects are uniform.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery supply the repeated incoming material that is first to be established and then said to add.
Repair, nurture, and completion mark the source orientation of both descents, sharpening the paradox of the adverse response.
Literal increase supplies the gain operation applied to the receivers' existing disposition.
Exceeding a limit supplies the adverse direction in which the added force travels.
Water rising with sweeping force gives the limit-crossing result a concrete overflow mechanism.
Covering supplies the simultaneous occlusion produced even while the quantity of response increases.

changed_reading.before: The newly revealed message simply causes additional unbelief in hostile hearers.
changed_reading.after: The descended message functions as an amplifying input: in many receivers its added force runs past limits and thickens covering rather than producing establishment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ at the opening and فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ at the close.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is charged with audible declaration but forbidden to carry the covered group's response as grief. The verse separates responsibility for faithful speech from emotional ownership of reception.

activation_trace.role: Utterance brought into speech establishes the messenger's required outward act.
Grief and consolation mark the affective burden that the closing prohibition limits.
The people as a social body are the object of grief, not an outcome the speaker can control.
The group's active covering of truth identifies the response state from which the speaker must detach responsibility.

changed_reading.before: Do not grieve can sound like indifference toward a condemned group.
changed_reading.after: The command is a boundary around the speaking duty: declare fully, but do not confuse faithful delivery with control over a community's covering response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding conditional repeats establishment and descent, then answers them with nourishment from above and beneath the feet. Upright enactment becomes the opening of a vertical circulation in which descended guidance supports embodied livelihood, while the balanced community shows the social form that can carry it.

activation_trace.role: Support, subsistence, and livelihood let establishment provide the focus verse's missing load-bearing ground.
The exact establishment verb supplies upright, balanced alignment as the condition of the circuit.
Delivered descent supplies the downward input paired with establishment.
Edible share and provision make the result material sustenance rather than only abstract approval.
Spatial height supplies the upper pole from which nourishment reaches the established community.
The underside beneath their feet supplies the lower pole, enclosing the body within provision.
Moderation between extremes gives the functioning community a balanced social profile.

structural_cues: 5:66 repeats the exact establishment condition one ayah earlier and immediately gives eating from above and beneath their feet as its result.
The balanced subset in 5:66 contrasts with the many whose actions are bad, anticipating the many adversely increased in 5:68.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies establishment, descent, vertical poles, nourishment, and a balanced subset; I infer a circulation from enacted guidance to livelihood. The live alternative is a straightforward conditional reward with no conduit relation.

changed_reading.before: Establishing scripture means complying with a textual demand so that reward follows.
changed_reading.after: Establishing scripture makes descended guidance load-bearing and opens a balanced vertical economy of nourishment around the community.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two adjacent ayat form a relay with two nullifying conditions. What descends must reach its goal through the messenger's full delivery in 5:67, then must be made upright by the receiving community in 5:68. Protection of the messenger and the ban on grief bound each agent's responsibility at the relevant stage.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message identify the upstream office and the entrusted transmission.
Causing the message to arrive supplies the first required relay operation and its explicit failure condition.
The same delivered descent that appears twice in the focus links the relay's incoming material across the ayah boundary.
Protective restraint frees the messenger to complete delivery without making him sovereign over reception.
Sustained care and governance define the downstream operation required from the receiving people.
The grief boundary closes the relay by separating complete declaration from control of its reception.

structural_cues: 5:67 says that failure to deliver nullifies the messenger's mission; 5:68 says that failure to establish nullifies the addressees' standing.
Both ayat repeat what was sent down from your Lord and close with the covering people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent nullifying conditionals around the same descended material; I infer sequential relay stages and stage-specific responsibility. They can alternatively be read as parallel but independent admonitions.

changed_reading.before: 5:68 is an isolated demand that another community observe its inherited books.
changed_reading.after: 5:68 is the receiving stage of a live transmission chain: descent must become full delivery, and delivered revelation must become maintained public enactment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context unfolds the focus's overflow as a failed boundary system. Desire-led following leaves the straight path, while the community's failure to restrain recognizable wrong removes its internal check. Establishing scripture therefore includes maintaining social practices that stop reception from spilling into excess.

activation_trace.role: Crossing a limit names the focus result that the later sequence supplies with a social mechanism.
Communal care and governance make establishment the positive boundary-maintaining alternative.
Following in another's wake supplies the transfer mechanism from desire to communal direction.
Inclination of the self supplies the force that replaces the established textual boundary.
Repeated loss of guidance and intended direction supplies the path outcome of desire-led following.
Intrinsic straightness and completeness provide the alignment from which the sequence departs.
The extended traversable path turns straightness into a maintained course rather than a static opinion.
Mutual restraint supplies the missing communal brake whose failure lets excess persist.
Recognizably ugly conduct supplies a concrete object that communal restraint should stop.

structural_cues: The branchless root غ ل و at 5:77 word 5 explicitly forbids excess in religion and is used here only as a structural cue.
5:79 shifts from individual error to a repeated reciprocal failure to restrain one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, desire-following, path loss, and failed mutual restraint; I infer a causal chain from absent establishment to tughyan. The charges could instead remain separate examples of wrongdoing.

changed_reading.before: Establishing the books chiefly means correct textual or ritual observance, while tughyan is a generic hostile attitude.
changed_reading.after: Establishment includes a communal boundary practice that checks recognizable wrong; without that brake, desire-led following carries the group beyond the straight course into tughyan.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descended input produces opposed overflow signatures. In the focus it adds sweeping tughyan and covering; in 5:83 understood hearing and recognition of truth fill the eyes until tears flow, followed by a request for enrollment among witnesses. The revelation exposes and amplifies the receiver's mode of reception.

activation_trace.role: Delivered descent supplies the common input whose divergent effects can be compared.
Increase supplies the amplification operation rather than a fixed moral quality of the input.
Sweeping water overflow supplies the adverse response signature.
Covering supplies the adverse receiver state that coexists with the overflow.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies an open reception channel.
The repeated descended message ties the positive response to the focus verse's same incoming material.
Easy abundant flowing supplies the positive overflow signature.
A vessel filled until it overflows makes the eyes a receptive container rather than a breached boundary.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies the discriminating operation that precedes tears.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies what recognition successfully identifies.
Enrollment in a register turns receptive overflow into a requested durable affiliation.
Presence with witnessing supplies the enacted body into which the responders ask to be written.

structural_cues: 5:68 and 5:83 both make what was sent down the immediate object encountered by a group.
The focus limits the adverse increase to many of them, while 5:83 supplies a visibly different subset and a second explicit overflow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared descent and the opposed overflow fields; I infer that revelation amplifies and discloses receiver orientation. The live alternative is rhetorical contrast without a common causal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The revelation itself is portrayed as producing more rebellion and unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The revelation is a differentiating amplifier: covered reception spills into tughyan, while recognizing reception fills and overflows as tears, confession, and witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus addresses an inherited book-affiliation but denies that label any settled standing. Later responders ask to be written into a witnessing body and admitted among a righteous people. Book identity shifts from possession of a corpus to enacted enrollment in a community that bears it.

activation_trace.role: Community of proximity and affiliation supplies the inherited collective label under examination.
Fitness and entitlement make ahl a testable qualification rather than an automatic credential.
The written corpus supplies the nominal object around which the inherited affiliation is formed.
Writing a name into a register or cohort converts book language into requested membership.
Testimony stated with knowledge defines the active vocation of the cohort.
Entry into an interior supplies a second movement from outside label to admitted belonging.
The people as a social body supply the destination of the requested entry.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the enacted quality of that people.

structural_cues: The focus's inherited label People of the Book is followed later by the voluntary request write us among the witnesses.
5:84 repeats the movement as entry among a qualified people rather than assertion of an inherited identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nominal affiliation, denied standing, enrollment, witness, and entry; I infer a contrast between inherited possession and enacted membership. The uses of writing may alternatively remain unrelated literal and administrative senses.

changed_reading.before: People of the Book names a settled community whose failure is inconsistency with its own possessions.
changed_reading.after: Book-affiliation is a claim tested by establishment; durable belonging appears as being written into a witnessing, sound social body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus itself says many, not all, and closes on the people in a covering state. Context preserves an open distribution: faith and sound action remove grief, some are nearest in affection because they do not magnify themselves, and some recognize the truth. The final non-grief command bounds responsibility without totalizing every book-affiliated addressee.

activation_trace.role: Numerical many explicitly leaves a remainder outside the adverse increase.
Covering truth defines the closing group's response state rather than merely repeating the opening affiliation.
The ban on grief is the focus boundary that the later open distribution revises.
Trusting assent supplies a response available across the named communal labels.
Sound action makes the open condition enacted rather than nominal.
The removal of grief from responsive people mirrors and differentiates the speaker's prohibition on grief.
Nearness rather than distance supplies a contrasting relational position within the broad address field.
Affection supplies a positive social orientation that cannot be absorbed into the covering group.
Negated self-magnification supplies a receptive posture opposed to resistant covering.
Recognition that becomes admission supplies an actual transition out of concealment.

structural_cues: The quantifier many in 5:68 prevents the adverse response from exhausting the opening addressees.
5:69 states an open condition across named communities, and 5:82-84 narrate a responsive subset inside the packet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quantifier, response labels, and contrasting subsets; I infer that the closing group is dynamically response-defined. The alternative is that each passage addresses fixed populations without revising the focus label.

changed_reading.before: Do not grieve over the covering people can be heard as a categorical dismissal of all People of the Book.
changed_reading.after: The command releases the speaker from owning the covered response of many while preserving real, enacted paths of recognition for other members of the address field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mappings of ر ب ب toward rising and ز ي د toward carried provision, then joins them to water and food images. It remains anchored in the focus's descent, increase, standing, support, and tughyan plus packet-local vertical nourishment and flow. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a lexical replacement for rabb or yazid.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins ن ز ل, ر ب ب, ز ي د, ق و م, and water-like ط غ ي around the demand to establish.

activation_trace.role: Downward arrival supplies the material input entering the proposed channel.
The split target's increase and rising image supplies pressure or growth, used analogically rather than as the lexical sense of Lord.
The split target's carried travel provision lets increase be pictured as added supply, explicitly at exploratory distance.
Support and subsistence make upright establishment the structure that can carry the supply.
Water overflow supplies the failure mode when added input crosses the channel's boundary.
Edible provision supplies the beneficial material output of establishment.
Cloud-borne pulses of water sharpen the upper-source image while remaining a branch analogy.
The underside beneath the feet supplies the lower receiving field.
Expansion from fullness supplies a receptive overflow that contrasts with channel failure.
Continuous provision and giving let successful flow terminate in sustained reward.
A river cutting a course through the ground supplies the image of contained, life-bearing flow.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts scriptural observance with aggravated rebellion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, descended provision enters a channel that must be held upright: established, it circulates nourishment and recognition; unchanneled, its added force floods the boundary as tughyan.

strongest_changes: Establishment became the receiving stage of a transmission relay and a maintained, load-bearing social practice rather than possession or recital.
The packet's tear overflow revised the adverse increase into a differential amplification model: one descent discloses opposed receiver orientations.
Book-affiliation became a tested enrollment in witness and sound communal action, while many prevented the closing judgment from totalizing the opening addressees.
summary.what_was_special: The immediate repetition of establishment and descent in 5:66-67 supplied the relay and vertical mechanisms, while the distant but exact descent-and-overflow mirror in 5:83 exposed the focus verse's strongest changed reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The circulation and receiver-amplifier arrows are abductive; the packet can support simpler conditional-reward and rhetorical-contrast readings.
The move from People of the Book to enrollment among witnesses depends on activating distinct كتاب branches across nominal and verbal forms.
The provisioning-channel outlier is deliberately form-distant and depends on split-root branch images, so it should remain explicitly exploratory.
